questions.q: What does a bank account transfer actually create underneath the hood?
options: A single journal entry with no reconciliation needed
Two external transactions: an outflow at the From account and an inflow at the To account
A new bank statement format
A Receivables receipt only
questions.explain: A transfer creates two linked external transactions, each needing its own reconciliation before it can be accounted.

questions.q: What is the difference between an intracompany and an intercompany bank transfer?
options: Intracompany is between accounts owned by the same legal entity; intercompany is between different legal entities
Intracompany always involves a currency conversion; intercompany never does
There is no difference; the terms are interchangeable
Intercompany transfers never need to be reconciled
questions.explain: Intracompany transfers stay within one legal entity's accounts; intercompany transfers move funds between accounts owned by different legal entities.

questions.q: Who calculates any gain or loss resulting from a currency conversion during a bank account transfer?
options: Cash Management calculates it directly during transfer entry
Subledger Accounting, when the Create Accounting process runs
The receiving bank calculates and reports it back to Oracle
No gain or loss is ever possible on a transfer
questions.explain: Cash Management just records the two transaction amounts; any FX gain or loss is calculated by Subledger Accounting during Create Accounting.

questions.q: Why isn't a bank transfer considered 'done' from an accounting standpoint the moment it's entered?
options: Because each of its two external transactions must still be reconciled against its own bank statement
Because transfers can never be accounted at all
Because Oracle requires a 30-day waiting period on all transfers
Because transfers are not visible until the next fiscal year
questions.explain: Both the outflow and inflow transactions need to be reconciled against their respective statements before accounting can complete.

questions.q: In the worked example, why is Harborview Metals Inc.'s weekly $50,000.00 sweep described as straightforward to reconcile?
options: Because it involves a currency conversion
Because it is an intercompany transfer requiring special setup
Because it is a same-currency, intracompany transfer between two of its own USD accounts
Because sweeps never need to be reconciled
questions.explain: The sweep stays within the same currency and the same legal entity, avoiding the added complexity of FX conversion or intercompany accounting.
